text:
Mira: Quick heads-up — the docs queue has a few PRs blocked on reviewer assignments and the docs preview is flaky this morning. Can someone pick up slots so we don't pile up before EOD?

Kevin: I can take the SDK-snippets PR (github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321). I won’t merge until docs-preview is green though — linkcheck is failing on one snippet.

DocsBot: [preview-status] PR #4321 — docs-preview: failed (linkcheck). Logs: https://ci.redwood/inference/4321/logs

Ana (docs): I’ll grab the migration guide PR (#4319) — quick pass for wording + callout for breaking schema change. Mira, can you re-run the preview for #4319? I fixed a relative link in the branch.

Mira: on it. Re-running previews now: ``/ci retry 4319`` and ``/ci retry 4321`` — FYI the GHA runner had a cache miss earlier so some runs need a rerun to pick up updated artifact.

Sam: Which ones are urgent if we need to prioritize? I can help with small link fixes and a quick reviewer pass for grammar.

Mira: Priority order: 1) migration guide #4319 (breaking), 2) SDK snippets #4321 (examples used in customer demo), 3) link-fix cluster #4330 (multiple tiny fixes).

Kevin: For #4321 the failing link is in the Java snippet; looks like a CDN path changed. Quick patch is two-line change. If DocsBot shows green after retry I'll run the patch and request a review from Ana.

Ana (docs): FYI policy: we need at least one docs reviewer + one maintainer approval for merges touching platform APIs. If Kevin fixes the CDN path, @Mira or @Sam can approve the final build green.

DocsBot: [preview-status] PR #4319 — docs-preview: success. Artifacts: s3://redwood-docs/previews/4319/index.html

Mira: #4319 looks good to me. Small nit about the migration example; leaving it as a comment on the PR. If Ana is happy, feel free to merge after CI.

Sam: I can take the link-fix cluster #4330. Pls assign to me and I’ll do a single commit with all small fixes. Also will run the local linkchecker before pushing.

Kevin: Re-ran #4321 preview: still failing but different error — missing Javadoc artifacts. I suspect the nightly build missed publishing. Tagging infra: @infra-build to confirm.

Mira: Noted. For merge timing — let's avoid merging anything that affects examples until the preview artifact URL is stable (we push those into the SDK demo harness). If infra can't resolve within an hour, we can create a docs-only patch that points to the fallback example and follow up with a second PR.

Ana (docs): Sounds good. I assigned #4330 to Sam. Kevin, once you have a green preview, @Ana (docs) will do final sign-off for API docs, @Mira will check examples.

DocsBot: [assign] PR #4330 assigned to Sam

Sam: Taking it now. ETA ~30–45m for the cluster.

Kevin: Quick question — if infra takes >2h, are we okay with a temporary link to the CDN fallback for the SDK snippet? Would prefer that over blocking the demo.

Mira: Yes — temporary fallback is OK but add a TODO comment in the PR that references the infra ticket so we remember to revert. Also include a one-sentence migration note in the changelog.

Ana (docs): Thanks all. I'll watch #4319 and #4321 and do final reviews as previews go green. If anyone needs merge rights while OOO, ping me and I'll add a specific maintainer as temporary approver in the PR. :thumbsup:

Mira: Appreciate it. Closing backlog surge plan: Kevin — SDK snippet; Sam — link fixes; Ana — migration guide + final sign-off. Re-check in here in 60m for status updates.

Sam: update: pushed fixes for #4330, triggered preview.

DocsBot: [preview-status] PR #4330 — docs-preview: queued

Kevin: infra responded — nightly artifacts delayed, infra is re-publishing now. I’ll re-run the preview once it lands.

Mira: thanks — will re-check in 45m. If anything else blocks, drop a short note here.
